title: Where Shall the Child of Sorrow Find
description: Where Shall the Child of Sorrow Find in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 972 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Orphan's Hymn”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Where shall the child of sor-row find A place for calm re-pose? Thou, Fa-ther of the fa-ther-less, Pi-ty the or-phan's woes!

lines: Where shall the child of sorrow find
What friend have I in heaven or earth,
What friend to trust but thee?
My father's dead — my mother's dead;
In thee the fatherless shall find
I've not a secret care or pain,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
